payload.instruction: Treat MAC as endpoint only. Execute via Bridge, PEN and WIP workers. Do not mark done until execution receipt exists.

thread_pack.purpose: Build Synal backbone for split-topic threads so tools, workers and specialists keep context when LLM threads fragment.
thread_pack.problem: Long threads split into many topics. One LLM loses context. Valuable ideas, decisions and actions get buried. The system needs common worker analysis plus topic-specialist routing.
thread_pack.target_model: One common Signal Analyst across all meetings, threads and queues; 729 topic specialists; 727 knowledge/control updates; Synal ledger as shared signal memory; two-way sharing through WIP, PEN and Bridge.
thread_pack.external_reference: thinkscape.ai pattern: swarm/small-group thinking and propagated insight

work_already_done.title: Synal backbone: lost ideas sweep then active thread routing

work_already_done.state: handoff receipt only; execution receipt still required

required_actions: Read issue #15 and its comment payloads.
Run lost_ideas.sweep across historical chats, chosen docs, WIP, PEN and receipts.
Seed Synal ledger or equivalent store with recovered ideas, decisions, contradictions, stalled actions, patterns and routing candidates.
Create at least 5 follow-up jobs from recovered ideas.
Wire threads.topic.route into active/new thread processing.
Write execution receipt under receipts/runtime and link queue/audit evidence.

docs_updates_required.change: Add mandatory common Signal Analyst attending all threads, meetings, queues, receipts and docs; routes topics, reconciles outputs, captures lost ideas, detects contradictions, simulates options and publishes to Synal/WIP/PEN/global docs.

Topic workers receive routed fragments and return judgement, next action, risk, queue payload, evidence requirement and definition of done. Support one or many LLMs, one or many people, short and long time horizons.

Synal ledger or equivalent output exists with seeded rows.
At least five follow-up jobs created.
Active thread routing can classify new fragments.
Execution receipt under receipts/runtime links queue/audit proof.
